verification_report.summary: Independent sequential verification confirms the construction: one fixed smooth nonclosed Hermitian background with bounded mass, a smooth density vanishing exactly quadratically on two real hypersurfaces, and uncountably many distinct normalized smooth solutions. No critical errors or mathematical gaps were found. Potential differences are flat relative to their separate constant interface values. The full readable report is saved at results/quadratic_density_nonuniqueness_01/verification_report.md.
